gaps.sentence: The house ___ is lovely, but the garden is tiny.
gaps.explanation: Noun + itself emphasises the noun: the house itself.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).

gaps.sentence: She should be ashamed of ___ for saying that.
It was not ___ midnight that the results were announced.
The meeting was put ___ until Thursday.
I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.

gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

gaps.sentence: The project ran ___ of money halfway through.
gaps.explanation: 'Run out of' = use up the supply.
